note: Generated from the local Assiut Desktop source tree without OCR. CVS, GIT and RRS folders sit physically under this Year 1 tree but their official module codes (CVS-206, GIT-207, RRS-209 -- Internal Bylaw 2023, pp.21-22) place them in Second year, not Year 1; they are inventoried here as found but excluded from the Year 1 priority/triage scope. Terminology, Psychology and Ethics have no explicit block code in the bylaw's Year 1 curriculum map (pp.19-20) and are recorded as unmapped pending Omar's ruling.
